sections.title: Morning Shift — Team 1 (06:30 – 14:30)
items: Equipment received: 4 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 1 x Ops Phone.
Commencing Alpha Route. Arrived at check-in corner of Victoria St East and Queen Street Headquarters. Welfare check:
Arrived at check-in Skyworld Entertainment Centre and Aotea Square, full sweep around the area. All clear.
Welfare check Bledisloe building alleyway behind Skyworld Entertainment Centre. All clear.
Welfare check through Strand Arcade. All clear.

Spotted the male vagrant who broke into Level 1 on Monday and assaulted the electrician on Tuesday midday, stationed outside Starbucks. Police were called to attend and reprimand the male for previous offences.
Standing by with police out front of HQ; event number secured from data specialist manager Ross.
Still standing by with police and the vagrant in question; additional information required by police for further investigation.
Mike (the electrician who was assaulted) has arrived outside HQ for a statement.
Statement from Mike completed; standing by for an outcome to report on.
Police will not arrest the suspect until they get approval from Customs; they will return to arrest him once approval comes through. They know who he is — a repeat offender.
Standing by middle of Queen Street to show presence and awaiting Team 2 for debrief.
Team 2 arrived; conducting debrief regarding the morning status and incidents.
Team 2 will patrol lower Queen Street while we patrol upper Queen Street.
Welfare check up to Victoria Street West:
Arrived at check-in top of Victoria Street and Federal St. All clear. Standing by to show presence before moving along.
Walking towards Wellesley St West from Federal St.
Welfare check 77 Convenience Store Wellesley St West. All clear. Ending Alpha Route, commencing Delta Route for upper Queen Street.
Response call from Glass Hut Bar, Vulcan Lane — suspicious person in building; relayed to Team 2.
Arrived at check-in corner of Wellesley Street East and Lorne St; conducting welfare check on stores along Lorne Street.
Response call from Glassons — suspicious individual inside the store; relayed to Team 2.
Standing by to show presence before moving to the next checkpoint.
Cut through back down to Queen Street; welfare check towards Aotea Square:
Arrived at check-in corner of Rutland St and Wakefield St. All clear.
Arrived at check-in Auckland Town Hall. All clear.
Tanuki Japanese Sake and Sushi Bar
Arrived at check-in Aotea Square. All clear.
Ending Delta Route and commencing Echo Route for upper Queen Street.
Arrived at check-in corner of Darby St and Queen St. All clear.
Swapping with Team 2; we will patrol lower Queen Street while Team 2 patrols upper Queen Street.
Welfare check Durham Street East and West alleyway; welfare check on stores within the vicinity. All clear.
Lunch break completed; standing by for changeover to afternoon shift.
Response call from Joe & Joe's regarding two couples refusing to leave the premises; assistance requested to move them along.
Arrived at the response call and escorted the two individuals without any resistance or physical altercation. Logged into Auror report.

sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:30 – 22:30)
items: Equipment received: 4 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 1 x Ops Phone.
All geared up and heading out to commence patrols towards lower Queen Street.
Commencing welfare checks on stores along Queen Street.
Welfare check completed, no issues to report. Standing by for security presence at the corner of Wyndham and Queen St.
Commencing patrols heading towards Commercial Bay.
Q Convenience Store and Britomart McDonald's all clear; commencing full sweep.
All clear, standing by for security presence.
Albert Mart all clear; continuing patrol.
At the corner of Wyndham and Albert St, heading to do welfare check on the St Patrick's Cathedral area.
Area all clear, standing by for security presence.
Spotted 3 vagrants with alcohol in hand; will monitor them from a distance.
The 3 vagrants headed towards Hobson St.
Heading to the office to do handover with B team.
Debrief completed; B team has signed off. Charging ops phone.

Nike, Starbucks, Localito, Queen St McDonald's, 77 Convenience Store, Timezone, Mid-City, Avachi's and the walkway towards Lorne St all clear. Nike has a POI in store; we stood by. A male vagrant was loitering in the area. (Photos/videos on file.) Heading towards Aotea Square.
Arrived at Aotea Square; commencing sweep.
Area all clear, standing by for security presence.
Welfare checks on Auckland Library and Lorne St all clear, no issues. Heading towards Chancery Square via Kitchener St.
Full sweep around the area, no issues. Standing by for security presence.
Freyberg and High St all clear. Heading towards Fort St.

Pocket Park, Fort St and Fort Lane including Right Track, Vapor King, 77 Convenience, Jo & Joe's, Vape Haven, Evan's Kebab and Wilson Carpark all clear. Standing by at Pocket Park due to vagrants selling items. (Photo on file.)
Gore St all clear including Auckland Harbour Suites, Chargrills, Mermaids, Smiley Mart, Giapo and City Liquor. Standing by for security presence.
Custom Mart and Q Convenience Store all clear.
Britomart McDonald's all clear. Standing by for security presence.
Heading to check on Commercial Bay.
Commercial Bay all clear. Heading towards Albert St.
Albert Mart all clear; continuing patrol.
Arrived at the corner of Albert and Wyndham St; heading towards Victoria St via Federal St.
Federal St all clear; checking up on businesses.
Areas all clear; heading towards Wellesley St.
Saw and assisted a male who fell off his skateboard; checking for injuries on the person. (Video on file.)
Heading to the office to have a break.

sections.title: Night Shift (22:30 – 06:30)
items: Equipment received: 4 x Keys, 2 x Body Cameras, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 1 x Ops Phone.
Standby in the office while ops phone on charge (on 11%).
Welfare check on Chatime, top of Queen Street, all clear, no issues.
Welfare check Queen Street McDonald's — manager informed us about a group of vagrants sitting in front of their store with a sign, asking if we can move them along.
Approached the group of vagrants to move along; they complied without any further issues.
Welfare check on Victoria St, top High Street.
Full sweep all around the Freyberg area and Chancery Square, all clear, no issues.
Standby Freyberg Square for any nearby calls and showing presence.
Patrol through Connel Street, bottom of High St, Fort St, White Lady, all clear, no issues.
Welfare check on Gore St, Auckland Harbour Suites, all clear, no issues. Beta complete.
Welfare check on Britomart, Commercial Bay, all clear, no issues.

Received a call from Hotel Debrett — manager reported a female vagrant forcing her way into the building and making a mess out front; we advised we were responding to a call and would attend as soon as possible.

Received a call from QFTAV regarding a male who had been cut off from drinks at the bar; the male had been asking customers to buy him a drink and, when the bar manager informed him, got upset and aggressive towards the bar staff.
Arrived at QFTAV; the male had just walked out of the bar. We let him know what happened and he complied, moving along without further issues.
Responding to the call from Hotel Debrett.
Arrived at Hotel Debrett; the female vagrant was still outside the building. We approached and advised her to move along; she complied and walked away without further issues.
Continuing our Delta Route from here.
Patrol upper Queen Street, all clear, no issues.
Welfare check on Aotea Square, Mayoral Drive, all clear, no issues.
Welfare check on 77 Convenience Store on Victoria Street, all clear, no issues.
Welfare check on Albert Mart Convenience Store, all clear, no issues.
Welfare check on Customs St, Custom Mart Convenience Store, all clear, no issues.
Welfare check on Fort Lane, Fort St, Jo & Joe, all clear, no issues.
Welfare check on High St, High Street Supermarket, all clear, no issues.
Welfare check on Chancery Square, Freyberg area, upper High Street, all clear, no issues.
Welfare check Lorne St, Auckland Library, all clear, no issues. Delta Route complete.
Check on Darby St, Elliott Street, all clear, no issues.
Patrolling up Victoria St, all clear, no issues.
Welfare check on 77 Convenience Store, all clear, no issues.
Patrolling Federal St towards Wyndham Street, all clear, no issues.
Patrolling down Wyndham St towards Queen St, all clear, no issues.
Welfare check on Q Convenience Store and Customs Mart, all clear, no issues.
Patrolling Fort Lane, Fort St and the bottom of High St, all clear, no issues.
Welfare check on High St Supermarket, all clear, no issues.
Full sweep all around Chancery Square and Freyberg Square, all clear, no issues. Echo Route complete.
Welfare check on the bottom of Hobson St, all clear.
Welfare check on 77 Convenience Store on top of Victoria Street, all clear, no issues.
Patrol down Victoria St towards Queen St, Lorne St, all clear, no issues. Charlie Route complete.
Received a call from Queen Street McDonald's reporting a vagrant male sleeping inside their lobby.
Responding to the Queen Street McDonald's call.
Arrived at Queen Street McDonald's; the vagrant male was still sleeping. We woke him and told him to move along; he complied and moved outside without further issues.
Handover to morning shift. Night shift concluded.
